newsitem.title: FINLAND: ENSO SEES MODEST PRICE TRENDS, VOLUMES UP.
newsitem.headline: ENSO SEES MODEST PRICE TRENDS, VOLUMES UP.

text.p: Finland's second largest forest industry group Enso Oy said on Wednesday it expected price trends to be modest though volumes would rise.
"Price trends will continue to be modest, despite the increase in sales volumes," Enso said in a statement with its first-half earnings.

Enso reported first-half profit after financial items down nearly 17 percent at 928 million markka, but said its full-year financial results would be somewhat better than in 1996, raising an earlier forecast for a flat profit.
Enso said recent trends in exchange rates were improving the competitiveness of the Nordic paper industry and that the strong pound sterling and dollar had raised prices in Finnish markka.
"Capacity utilisation rates at the mills are expected to remain normal during the rest of the year," it said.
